per_frame.summary: This is the **GitHub login page**, featuring fields for username/email and password, a green "Sign in" button, options to continue with Google or Apple, and links to create an account, reset a password, or sign in with a passkey.
The **Username or email address** input field became focused (active), as indicated by the blue border highlight around it in the second screenshot.
The username field changed from empty/focused (with a blue border) to filled with the text "zhizhongs" (with a neutral border).
The username field changed from "zhizhongs" to "zhizhongs@uchicago.edu", indicating the user added their email domain to complete their full university email address.
The password field became focused (active), as indicated by the blue highlight/border appearing around it in the second screenshot.
A password was entered in the password field (shown as dots/bullets) between the two screenshots.
The password field lost focus (the blue border highlight disappeared and the cursor is no longer visible) between the two screenshots.

The user successfully entered their credentials (email: zhizhongs@uchicago.edu and password) and clicked "Sign in," which navigated them to the Two-factor authentication page where GitHub is awaiting approval via the GitHub Mobile app.
The sign-in request via GitHub Mobile timed out, resulting in an error message ("Sign-in request timed out. We could not verify your identity") and the appearance of a "Retry GitHub Mobile" button.
The sign-in request timed out error was dismissed and the "More options" menu was expanded, revealing the **Authenticator app** and **2FA recovery code** alternative authentication options.

The screen transitioned from the **GitHub Mobile app push notification** 2FA method (with options for Authenticator app and 2FA recovery code) to the **Authenticator app** 2FA method, displaying a code entry field (XXXXXX) and a "Verify" button.
The user successfully completed two-factor authentication on GitHub and was redirected to their personal GitHub Dashboard homepage logged in as **zhizhongs**.
